name: freeciv
desc: Free and Open Source empire-building strategy game
why: A capable open-source civilization-style strategy game that is a close call against the games bar.

brief.what_it_is: Freeciv is a free and open source empire-building strategy game inspired by the history of human civilization. It ships as a server plus several clients: freeciv-server, freeciv-gtk4 (single player GTK4 client), freeciv-mp-gtk4 (multiplayer GTK4 client), freeciv-manual, and freeciv-ruleup. The homepage and README describe no inputs or outputs beyond playing the game itself.
brief.why_it_exists: The README offers only the one-line framing: an empire-building strategy game inspired by the history of human civilization, released as Free and Open Source software under GPL v2.
brief.install_notes: The README and homepage give no install steps, runtime requirements, or first-run configuration. The README points to a doc directory for documentation but I did not follow it. The Homebrew executable list shows the separate server and GTK4 client binaries, so a multiplayer game needs freeciv-server running with clients connecting to it.
brief.standout: Freeciv is a long-running, community-built open source take on the Civilization-style 4X game, with a separate server and client architecture that supports multiplayer. The homepage also advertises Longturn, a one-turn-per-day multiplayer community, which suggests play that spans days or weeks rather than one sitting.
brief.status: Maintained. The homepage lists stable 3.2.6 released 04 Sep 2026, with news items through 15 Oct 2026 (a Fluxer chat channel opened). Earlier 3.2.x bugfix releases are listed through 2026, and the GitHub repo has an active CI badge. Last commit date not checked.
brief.caveats: The README is thin: no commands, no install instructions, no screenshots. Brew caveats are empty. The 3.2.6 release notes say it fixes two security vulnerabilities in savegame and scenario file handling, and 3.2.4 fixed a networking security issue, so keep up with point releases. Platform and licence details beyond GPL v2 were not checked.
quotes: Freeciv is a Free and Open Source empire-building strategy game inspired by the history of human civilization.
